course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Calculate the capitalized cost of a project that has an initial cost of 150,000 (17) Tk and additional investment of 50,000 Tk after 12 years. The annual operating cost will be 5000 Tk for the first 5 years and 8000 Tk thereafter. There is expected to be a recurring major rework cost of 15,000 Tk in every years. Use, i = 15% per year.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
